# 省 — ministry; omit

**Strokes:** 9 · **Key (radical):** 目 (no. 109) · **JLPT:** N2 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

省 appears in government-ministry vocabulary and in words about omitting, economizing or reflecting on oneself. Its separate readings belong to particular words; do not infer a single translation or pronunciation that works in all compounds.

## Meaning and origin

営 concerns running a business or carrying on an activity. 営業 えいぎょう is business activity or sales, while 経営 けいえい emphasizes management or running an enterprise. 営む いとなむ also extends to carrying on a life or conducting a ceremony.

## Meaning and origin

政 concerns governing and public affairs. Start with [政治](../words/政治.md) せいじ,
"politics": the decisions and activities involved in governing, rather than simply a particular government office.

## Common words

- [政治](../words/政治.md) せいじ — politics; government
- 政府 せいふ — government; administration

## Notes

[正](正.md) lacks the right-hand 攵. [教](教.md) and [敗](敗.md) share that right-hand form,
but neither means politics. 政府 names the governing administration; 政治 names the sphere of political activity.

## Meaning and origin

係 appears in [関係](../words/関係.md) かんけい, a relationship or connection.
As the word 係 かかり, it can identify a duty or the person responsible for it.
These uses help connect involvement with having an assigned role, without making the words interchangeable.

## Meaning and origin

教 concerns teaching and instruction; in some compounds it also concerns a doctrine or faith. The everyday verb 教える includes telling someone information, not just teaching a lesson.

## Common words

- [教える](../words/教える.md) おしえる — teach; tell someone information
- 教わる おそわる — be taught, learn from someone
- [教室](../words/教室.md) きょうしつ — classroom
- 教科書 きょうかしょ — textbook
- [儒教](../words/儒教.md) じゅきょう — Confucianism
- [准教授](../words/准教授.md) じゅんきょうじゅ — associate professor

## Notes

教える views the exchange from the instructor's side; 教わる views it from the learner's side. The verb is not limited to school: a person can 教える a name or an address.

## Meaning and origin

師 points to a teacher, master, or practitioner with a particular skill.
Compare [教師](../words/教師.md) きょうし, a teacher, with 医師 いし, a physician.
These name different professions; the shared character does not mean that every specialist teaches a class.

## Meaning and origin

訓 concerns instruction, precepts and explaining or reading written characters. It also names a native Japanese kanji reading, a 訓 くん, in contrast with an on reading.

| クン | on | [訓練](../words/訓練.md) くんれん - training; drill |
| キン | on | 家訓 かきん - family precepts; family motto |
| おし.える | kun | Source-only reading. JMdict indexes 訓える おしえる - teach; instruct (search-only kanji form); this index form is not a recommended word example. |
| よ.む | kun | Source-only reading. JMdict indexes 訓む よむ - read with a native Japanese reading (search-only kanji form); this index form is not a recommended word example. |
| くん.ずる | kun | 訓ずる くんずる - read kanji using its native Japanese pronunciation (rare word/use) |

KANJIDIC2 records おし.える and よ.む. JMdict retains 訓える and 訓む as search-only kanji forms: the rows above are explicitly index evidence, not ordinary recommended spellings. For the teaching word, use 教える おしえる; 読む よむ is the non-index reading spelling in its family. The specific 訓む sense concerns reading a kanji with its native Japanese reading, not a recommendation to respell every occurrence of 読む.

## Common words

- [訓](../words/訓.md) くん - native Japanese kanji reading
- [訓練](../words/訓練.md) くんれん - training; drill

## Notes

- The キン row uses the attested 家訓 かきん. The same entry also has かくん; dictionary order or a missing frequency flag does not by itself establish how frequent either reading is.
- JMdict marks 訓ずる くんずる as a rare term. It illustrates the source reading without making it an everyday verb recommendation.

## Meaning and origin

詰 concerns packing or pressing things together and reaching a tight or final point. Its extensions include close questioning and being checkmated; they are not all literal acts of filling a container.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** See 言 on the left and the compact 吉-shaped right side, with 士 stacked tightly over 口. Imagine words squeezed into a small space; this is a mnemonic, not etymology.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| キツ | on | 詰問 きつもん - close questioning; demanding an explanation |

## Meaning and origin

圧 expresses pressure or pressing down and can also concern oppression. 圧力 あつりょく names pressure, both physical pressure and pressure exerted on people or organizations.

## Notes

- The オウ example 圧状 is a dictionary example with an archaic document sense; JMdict also gives a rare coercion sense. It is not a recommendation for ordinary modern correspondence.
- JMdict marks 圧す おす and 圧さえる おさえる as search-only kanji forms. They explain dictionary indexing, not normal spellings to copy into new sentences. The separate 圧す へす entry is archaic.

## Meaning and origin

願 concerns wishing for an outcome or making a request.
[願う](../words/願う.md) ねがう is the verb; 願い (ねがい) is a wish or request.
みんなの幸せを願っています。 (みんなのしあわせをねがっています。) — I hope everyone will be happy.

## Common words

- [願う](../words/願う.md) ねがう — wish for; request
- 願い ねがい — wish; request
- お願い おねがい — request; please

## Notes

お願い is a polite request expression; recognize it without assuming every occurrence of 願 has the same level of politeness.
[頼](頼.md) also concerns requests; compare the whole words to see whether they express a wish, a request, or reliance.
